doc.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Joining Basie and life on the bus
title: His band of the mid-1950s and touring with Joe Williams
summary: He led a New York group with Elvin Jones and Tommy Flanagan, and toured with Joe Williams through Basie's office.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I guess it was about ’65, because my daughter was born in 1965. It was about 1962, ’63, something like that. I had a band…’55, ’56, ’57, ’58, I had Elvin Jones, Tommy Flanagan, Jimmy Forest, and Tommy Potter. I had that band for about four or five years.
Were you based in New York with that band?
You travelled a lot with them?

Yes, in fact when Joe Williams left the Count Basie band, Basie’s office was my manager and they were managing Joe Williams too, so they put us together on his first tour without the Basie band. And we stayed together for about three years. And about four years we travelled together.
